name: eca-ecommerce-agent
description: Ecommerce Academy skills bundle — brand intelligence, hero product analysis, email marketing campaigns, competitor analysis, Meta ad copywriting, customer persona building, SEO and AI blog writing, UGC video scripts, store visibility audits, Meta ads analysis (4PI), the ECA Reel Editor (a raw talking-head clip → an on-brand reel or video ad with product, review and offer cards from your store), and post-purchase surveys from writing the questions to turning the answers into angles, objections and personas. New skills are added here over time; installing this one plugin keeps you current with all of them.  What's new (v1.17.4): the Reel Editor now always edits on EcomOS when it is connected (upload the clip on EcomOS → Marketing Apps → Reel Editor; nothing is downloaded or installed in Claude); the local path is only used on request in Claude Code on your own machine.
